newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Sept industrial output up 7.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Sept industrial output up 7.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: South Korea's industrial output rose 7.3 percent year on year in September, compared with an 11.5 percent rise a year earlier, provisional figures by the National Statistical Office (NSO) showed on Wednesday.
The office said in a statement industrial output for the third quarter of this year rose 8.0 percent year-on-year, against a 13.2 percent gain a year earlier.
Note: figures in percent, year-on-year change.
The statement said industrial output fell 0.7 percent in September over the previous month, against a 0.7 percent month-to-month rise a year earlier.
Semiconductors, office equipment and automobiles led industrial output growth in September, it said.

Production of semiconductors and electronics parts was up 31.1 percent year-on-year while production of office equipment and automobiles rose 25.1 percent and 15.6 percent respectively, the statement said.
But semiconductors and automobiles were also the main contributors to the growth in inventories, it said.
Inventories for electronics parts, including semiconductors, were up 112.7 percent year-on-year and those for automobiles rose 43.1 percent, it said.
